boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Andrews University
boards.description: Navigate the unique late-night landscape of Berrien Springs, where campus vegetarian staples and regional 24-hour spots define the student experience after dark.

cards.title: The Gazebo
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Grab-and-Go
cards.notes: Visit the Campus Center for late-night vegetarian snacks and retail items. It remains a primary hub for students seeking food after the main dining hall closes.
cards.short_summary: The Gazebo is the central on-campus retail dining spot, offering vegetarian-friendly snacks and meals with extended evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gazebo offers retail-only hours until 9:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday and Sunday, serving as the primary late-night campus food source.
cards.source_title: Dining Services and Gazebo Hours - Andrews Agenda
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:30 p.m. for retail items most weeknights and Sundays; hours are significantly reduced on Fridays for the Sabbath.

cards.title: World Market Pizza
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Campus Slices
cards.notes: Head to the Dining Center for vegetarian pizza options during special late-night events. It is a go-to for student gatherings and weekend late sessions.
cards.short_summary: Located within the Dining Center, World Market Pizza provides vegetarian pizza options often available during extended event hours.
cards.evidence_claim: World Market Pizza has been documented to operate until 12:00 a.m. during specific campus events like the International Food Fair.
cards.access_notes: Late-night availability is typically tied to specific university events or weekend schedules; check the weekly Agenda for current hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Express Mart Late-Night
cards.notes: Drive to the Express Mart for a late-night bean burrito. This location is a staple for students due to its proximity and vegetarian-friendly menu.
cards.short_summary: A popular off-campus fast-food destination located in the Express Mart, known for its late-night availability and vegetarian options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 616 Saint Joseph Ave in Berrien Springs offers late-night service, typically closing at midnight or later.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Menu in Berrien Springs, MI - Express Mart 616 Saint Joseph Ave
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru typically remains open until 12:00 a.m. or later daily.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Saint Joseph Road Drive-Thru
cards.notes: Grab a late-night McFlurry or fries at this local standby. It is one of the few consistent late-night options within the village limits.
cards.short_summary: The local McDonald's provides a reliable late-night drive-thru option for students just south of the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 575 Saint Joseph Rd offers drive-thru service with hours extending late into the night.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is open late; lobby hours may vary.

cards.title: Applebee's Grill + Bar
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Half-Price Apps
cards.notes: Make the short drive to Niles for half-price appetizers after 9 p.m. It is a common destination for groups looking for a sit-down meal late at night.
cards.short_summary: A regional favorite in nearby Niles, offering a full menu and discounted appetizers during late-night hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Applebee's in Niles features a 'Late Night' menu with half-price appetizers available from 9 p.m. until closing.
cards.source_title: Applebee's Grill + Bar in Niles, MI
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 p.m. or 12:00 a.m. depending on the day of the week.

cards.title: Meijer
cards.subtitle: Midnight Grocery Run
cards.notes: Stock up on dorm essentials or late-night snacks at this massive grocery store. It is the primary destination for bulk shopping near campus.
cards.short_summary: A large 24-hour (or near 24-hour) supercenter in Stevensville that serves as a critical resource for student supplies after hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stevensville Meijer is open daily from 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m., providing a wide window for late-night shopping.
cards.access_notes: Currently open until 12:00 a.m. daily.

cards.title: James White Library
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Study Sessions
cards.notes: Utilize the library's extended hours during finals week for quiet study. It is the academic heart of campus for night owls.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offers extended hours during the academic semester, providing a dedicated space for late-night research and study.
cards.evidence_claim: James White Library typically operates until 11:00 p.m. or 12:00 a.m. during peak academic periods Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: James White Library Hours - Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Hours are reduced on Fridays and Saturdays; check the official library calendar for current semester schedules.

cards.title: Walgreens
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Pharmacy & Snacks
cards.notes: Pick up emergency supplies or snacks at this 24-hour location. It is the most reliable spot in town for late-night needs.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour pharmacy and convenience store located on the main road through Berrien Springs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Walgreens at 901 S State Rd in Berrien Springs is a 24-hour location, providing around-the-clock access to retail goods.
cards.source_title: Walgreens Store Locator - Berrien Springs, MI
cards.access_notes: Store is open 24 hours daily; pharmacy hours may differ.

cards.title: Buller Hall
cards.subtitle: Undergraduate Study Hub
cards.notes: Find a quiet corner in the Randall Lounge for late-evening group projects. This building is a central academic hub for undergraduate students.
cards.short_summary: Buller Hall is a primary academic building featuring lounges and classrooms frequently used for late-evening study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Buller Hall hosts various evening events and is a documented favorite study spot for students, often accessible until late evening.
cards.access_notes: Access is generally available during building hours; after-hours access typically requires specific permission or card swipe.

cards.title: Campus Center Lobby
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Social Space
cards.notes: Gather with friends in the lobby for late-night conversations. It serves as the living room of the campus where students congregate after hours.
cards.short_summary: The Campus Center lobby is a central social space that remains open late for student interaction and informal meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center is the main hub for student life and remains open late to accommodate the Gazebo and student organization offices.
cards.access_notes: Open late daily to support student services and retail dining; check for Sabbath-related early closures on Friday evenings.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the quiet corners and functional student spaces at Andrews University, from fireside lounges to specialized resource centers.

cards.title: Fireside Study in Buller Hall
cards.subtitle: Student Commons at the Undergraduate Learning Center
cards.notes: Find a spot by the fireplace in the Student Commons for a cozy study session between core undergraduate classes.
cards.short_summary: A popular student lounge in Buller Hall featuring a fireplace and comfortable seating for studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Students are noted to study by the fireplace in the Student Commons of Buller Hall at almost any time during the day.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours, typically Monday through Friday for undergraduate students.

cards.title: Quiet Reflection at the Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Second Floor of Harrigan Hall
cards.notes: Visit the second floor to find a quiet space surrounded by student and faculty artwork, ideal for sitting and thinking.
cards.short_summary: A quiet art gallery on the second floor of Harrigan Hall showcasing BFA and BA student exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Gallery in Harrigan Hall offers a quiet space to immerse oneself in art and escape from studying.
cards.source_title: Art @ AU: Harrigan's Gallery - Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. during building operation.

cards.title: Collaborative Study in the Library
cards.subtitle: James White Library Lower Level
cards.notes: Reserve the lower level group study room for collaborative projects that require a dedicated team space.
cards.short_summary: A reservable group study room located on the lower level of the James White Library.
cards.evidence_claim: James White Library has three study rooms for collaborative study, with one located at the lower level.
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via LibCal; available to currently enrolled students.

cards.title: Quiet Study in the Science Complex
cards.subtitle: Third Floor Lobby Area
cards.notes: Head to the third floor for a quiet atmosphere where you can easily find professors for quick questions.
cards.short_summary: A quiet lobby area on the third floor of the Science Complex favored by students for focused study.
cards.evidence_claim: Student interviews identify the lobby on the third floor of the Science Complex as a favorite quiet study spot.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Science Complex building hours.

cards.title: Wellness Center Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Andreasen Center for Wellness Lobby
cards.notes: Use the well-designed lounge in the wellness lobby for gatherings or individual study near the Boba cafe.
cards.short_summary: A modern study and gathering space located in the lobby of the Andreasen Center for Wellness.
cards.evidence_claim: The wellness lobby, known as Hoilette Commons, includes a lounge with space for study and gatherings.
cards.access_notes: Open during wellness center hours; accessible to students with membership.

cards.title: Education Hub Study Room
cards.subtitle: Bell Hall Academic Space
cards.notes: Utilize the dedicated student study room in Bell Hall, located near the School of Education departments.
cards.short_summary: A designated study room for students located within Bell Hall, home to the School of Education.
cards.evidence_claim: A virtual tour of Bell Hall identifies a specific 'Student Study Room' and 'Graduate Study Room' on the premises.
cards.access_notes: Available during Bell Hall building hours for students.

cards.title: Math Help in Haughey Hall
cards.subtitle: Haughey Hall Room 112
cards.notes: Drop by Room 112 for free assistance with math assignments or to use the computer lab for web-based work.
cards.short_summary: A resource center in Haughey Hall providing free drop-in math assistance and computer access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mathematics Center in Haughey Hall Room 112 provides free drop-in assistance and eight computers for student use.
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday through Thursday, 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. for drop-in assistance.

cards.title: Secluded Study in Lamson Hall
cards.subtitle: First Floor Back Lobby
cards.notes: Find the study room in the back lobby of the first floor for a large, quiet space where you can focus alone.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study room located in the first-floor back lobby of the Lamson Hall residence.
cards.evidence_claim: Students recommend the study room in the back lobby of the first floor in Lamson Hall for its quiet and large space.
cards.access_notes: Primary access for residents; check residence hall policies for guest study access.

cards.title: Health Sciences Study in Marsh Hall
cards.subtitle: Marsh Hall Academic Building
cards.notes: Study near the School of Nursing and Nutrition departments in Marsh Hall, a hub for health and human services students.
cards.short_summary: Academic and student spaces within Marsh Hall, serving the nursing and nutrition programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Marsh Hall is the home of the School of Nursing and Nutrition & Wellness departments, providing academic spaces for these students.
cards.access_notes: Open during Marsh Hall building hours.

cards.title: Business Hub Study Space
cards.subtitle: Chan Shun Hall Main Entrance
cards.notes: Use the lobby and departmental areas in Chan Shun Hall for quick study sessions between business and marketing classes.
cards.short_summary: The main lobby and student areas of Chan Shun Hall, which houses the School of Business Administration.
cards.evidence_claim: Chan Shun Hall is identified on campus maps as the location for Accounting, Economics, Finance, and Management/Marketing.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Chan Shun Hall building hours.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore the best free social and recreational spots at Andrews University, from archaeological treasures and nature trails to late-night stargazing and campus farm visits.

cards.title: Play a Round of Disc Golf
cards.subtitle: 18-Hole Course Near Howard Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Tee off at this 18-hole course winding through the campus arboretum. It is free for students and the community; residents can borrow discs from their hall's front desk.
cards.short_summary: An 18-hole disc golf course open to the public and students for free play.
cards.evidence_claim: This course is free to all students, campus community, and the community at large.
cards.access_notes: Open sunrise to 11 p.m. Closed from sunset Friday to sunset Saturday for Sabbath observance.

cards.title: Explore Ancient Artifacts
cards.subtitle: Institute of Archaeology
cards.notes: View over 8,500 artifacts from the ancient Near East, including cuneiform tablets and pottery. Admission is free for students and the public during open hours.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum housing a significant collection of Near Eastern archaeological finds.
cards.evidence_claim: The Siegfried H. Horn Museum is open to the public on Saturdays from 3:00-5:00 pm when the university is in session.
cards.access_notes: Open Saturdays 3-5 p.m. during the academic year. Closed during summer and winter breaks.

cards.title: Hike the Campus Trail System
cards.subtitle: 11 Miles of Wooded Paths
cards.notes: Explore over 11 miles of single-track mountain bike and walking trails. Access the trailhead near the Pathfinder Building for a quiet escape into the woods.
cards.short_summary: A vast network of multi-use trails located on the northwest side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Andrews University's trails are open all year round. Enjoy forested trails and hills... without even leaving campus.
cards.access_notes: Open year-round during daylight hours. Main access points at the Pathfinder Building or Campbell Drive.

cards.title: Stargaze at Skywatch
cards.subtitle: Public Observing Program
cards.notes: Join the Physics Department for free public stargazing sessions. Use high-resolution telescopes to view planets and constellations on select weekend nights.
cards.short_summary: Free public astronomy events held at the campus observatory on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Unless otherwise noted, all events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Observatory Calendar of Events - Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Events typically start 60-90 minutes after sunset. Check the online calendar for weather-dependent updates.

cards.title: Visit the Campus Farm Animals
cards.subtitle: Sustainable Agriculture Education Center
cards.notes: Stop by the Ag Ed Center to see sheep, goats, and cows. It is a popular spot for students to relax and interact with animals in a farm setting.
cards.short_summary: An educational farm facility on campus where visitors can see various livestock.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ag Ed Center is open to visitors... I recommend that people definitely go in the springtime, because that's when the goats and the sheep will be giving birth.
cards.access_notes: Open to visitors during daylight hours. Check with the Department of Sustainable Agriculture for specific visiting protocols.

cards.title: Discover Adventist History
cards.subtitle: Lower Level of James White Library
cards.notes: Explore rare books, manuscripts, and artifacts related to Seventh-day Adventist heritage. View the original trunk used by J.N. Andrews on his historic mission.
cards.short_summary: A research center and archive dedicated to the history of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center's collection includes rare books, a handwritten bible, scrolls and Sir Isaac Newton manuscripts... available for your viewing pleasure.
cards.access_notes: Located in the James White Library. Open Monday-Thursday 9 a.m.-5 p.m. and Friday 9 a.m.-1 p.m. Closed Saturdays.

cards.title: Attend a Student Recital
cards.subtitle: Free Music Performances
cards.notes: Enjoy high-quality music performances by talented students and faculty. Most student recitals are free and open to the public in this world-class concert hall.
cards.short_summary: A premier concert venue hosting free student and faculty music recitals.
cards.evidence_claim: Student recitals are free, open to the public and take place in the Howard Performing Arts Center.
cards.access_notes: Check the Howard Center calendar for specific recital dates and times. Doors typically open 30 minutes before the performance.

cards.title: See the Prillwitz Mammoth
cards.subtitle: Price Hall, Science Complex
cards.notes: Visit the Science Complex to see a nearly complete woolly mammoth skeleton found locally. The museum also features extensive shell and bird collections.
cards.short_summary: A natural history museum featuring a woolly mammoth and diverse biological specimens.
cards.evidence_claim: The star of the show is definitely the woolly mammoth, but the museum also includes... more than 30,000 marine shells.
cards.access_notes: Located in Price Hall. Accessible during building hours, typically Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.

cards.title: Relax at The Grove
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Study and Social Space
cards.notes: Find this quiet pavilion tucked into the woods across from the Science Complex. It is an ideal spot for outdoor studying or a picnic with friends.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful outdoor pavilion located in a wooded area of the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: This small building is located across from the science complex in the woods... equipped with long benches and tables.
cards.source_title: Nature Spots on Campus - Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Open to the public and students 24/7. No lighting at night; best used during daylight hours.

cards.title: Join a Community Potluck
cards.subtitle: Social Events at PMC
cards.notes: Participate in various free community events like 'Meet, Greet & Eat' potlucks. These gatherings offer a chance to connect with the local community over a meal.
cards.short_summary: A campus church hosting free social and community-building events.
cards.evidence_claim: Meet and greet over potluck soup & salad... This program is co-ed and free. All are welcomed.
cards.access_notes: Events held periodically; check the PMC website or campus agenda for the next scheduled gathering.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: From the quiet carrels of James White Library to the light-filled lobby of the Howard Performing Arts Center, these ten study environments at Andrews University offer diverse settings for focused academic work.

cards.title: Collaborative Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: James White Library Upper and Lower Levels
cards.notes: Reserve one of three dedicated group rooms for team projects. These spaces feature large tables and are bookable online through the library's LibCal system.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms located on the upper and lower levels of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: James White Library has three study rooms for collaborative study. One is located at the lower level and two at the Upper Level.
cards.access_notes: Online reservation required; priority given to groups of two or more students.

cards.title: Fireplace Student Commons
cards.subtitle: Buller Hall First Floor
cards.notes: Study in a cozy atmosphere by the fireplace in the main commons. This Gothic-style hall provides a comfortable lounge setting for reading and light laptop work.
cards.short_summary: A collegiate gothic student lounge featuring a fireplace and comfortable seating for casual study.
cards.evidence_claim: At almost any time during the day, you'll find students studying by the fireplace in the Student Commons.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours, typically 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM on weekdays.

cards.title: Bill Chobotar Biology Commons
cards.subtitle: Science Complex, Price Hall Second Floor
cards.notes: Gather in this central hub for biology students to study or unwind. The space is designed for both individual focus and social academic interaction.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student commons on the second floor of Price Hall within the Science Complex.
cards.evidence_claim: A focal point for the second floor of Price Hall is the Bill Chobotar Biology Student Commons, a place where students can gather to study.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during Science Complex operating hours.

cards.title: Third Floor Quiet Lobby
cards.subtitle: Science Complex Upper Level
cards.notes: Utilize this quiet upper-floor lobby for deep concentration. Its proximity to faculty offices makes it ideal for students who may need to drop in for help.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, high-level lobby area favored by science students for its peaceful environment.
cards.evidence_claim: My favorite study spot is the lobby on the third floor of the Science Complex. I like it there because it is quiet.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible within the Science Complex; best for silent study.

cards.title: The Art Gallery Study Nook
cards.subtitle: Harrigan Hall Second Floor
cards.notes: Find inspiration among student exhibits in this quiet gallery space. It serves as a peaceful retreat for thinking and reading away from traditional desks.
cards.short_summary: A quiet art gallery on the second floor of Harrigan Hall that doubles as a reflective study space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Gallery offers a quiet space to immerse yourself... it is a cool spot to sit and think, or just a quiet place to escape to from studying.
cards.source_title: Art @ AU: Harrigan's Gallery - Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Light-Filled Howard Lobby
cards.subtitle: Howard Performing Arts Center Main Entrance
cards.notes: Enjoy floor-to-ceiling windows and natural light in this spacious lobby. It offers a scenic view of the campus heart, perfect for daytime study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A bright, open lobby with expansive windows and views of the central campus.
cards.evidence_claim: With floor to ceiling windows which allow lots of natural light, the lobby has a feeling of openness and a view that looks out to the heart of the Andrews University campus.
cards.source_title: Andrews University :: Facility Rentals - Howard Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Open during business hours and performance events; check schedule for availability.

cards.title: Campus Center Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Main Level
cards.notes: Study in the hub of student life near dining and recreation. This area is ideal for those who prefer a more active background hum while working.
cards.short_summary: A central student lounge located in the Campus Center, close to dining and student services.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Center (AUSA, Campus & Student Life, Dining Services... Recreation Center, Student Involvement).
cards.access_notes: Open daily; hours may vary during holidays and breaks.

cards.title: Theological Seminary Library
cards.subtitle: James White Library Main Level
cards.notes: Access specialized theological collections in this quiet wing. It provides a scholarly atmosphere with extensive resources in biblical studies and history.
cards.short_summary: A specialized research library within the James White Library building, offering quiet study among theological texts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Seminary Library is an integral part of the James White Library... It provides collections and services that support the Seminary students.
cards.access_notes: Open during James White Library hours; specifically supports graduate and seminary research.

cards.title: Lamson Hall First Floor Lobby
cards.subtitle: Lamson Hall Residence Wing
cards.notes: Find a secluded study room in the back lobby of this residence hall. It offers a large, quiet space for residents and visitors to focus without distractions.
cards.short_summary: A quiet residential lobby study room located on the first floor of Lamson Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: My favorite study spot is a study room in the back lobby of the first floor located in Lamson Hall.
cards.access_notes: Primarily for residents; visitors should check residence hall access policies.

cards.title: Chan Shun Hall Business Lounge
cards.subtitle: Chan Shun Hall Main Floor
cards.notes: Study in the professional environment of the School of Business Administration. The lobby provides seating suitable for individual work or quick meetings.
cards.short_summary: A professional study lounge located within the School of Business Administration building.
cards.evidence_claim: Chan Shun Hall (Accounting/Economics/Finance, Management/Marketing).
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic building hours.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the essential corridors and blocks surrounding Andrews University in Berrien Springs, featuring local markets, historic sites, and student-friendly hangouts.

cards.title: Old US 31 Corridor
cards.subtitle: Old US 31 Highway
cards.notes: Visit this popular sandwich shop for fresh-baked French-style baguettes and salads, located just south of the main campus entrance.
cards.short_summary: A staple sandwich shop on the Old US 31 corridor near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Baguette de France is located at 9187 Old US 31 Hwy in Berrien Springs, serving fresh baked sandwiches and salads.
cards.access_notes: Open for dine-in and takeout during standard business hours.

cards.title: St. Joseph Avenue Block
cards.subtitle: North St. Joseph Avenue
cards.notes: Stop by this community-focused coffee house for fair-trade brews and scratch-made vegan bakery items in a cozy setting.
cards.short_summary: A fair-trade coffee shop and bakery on St. Joseph Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Revive Coffee & More is located at 636 N. St. Joseph Avenue in Berrien Springs, offering single-origin coffee and a scratch-made bakery menu.
cards.access_notes: Standard daytime coffee shop hours; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: International Market Block
cards.subtitle: Old US 31 Highway
cards.notes: Browse a wide selection of international groceries and enjoy authentic Mexican and Caribbean dishes at this family-owned market.
cards.short_summary: An international grocery market and restaurant on Old US 31.
cards.evidence_claim: Melendez Imports is located at 8938 Old US 31 in Berrien Springs, combining a restaurant with an international grocery store.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Saturday; Caribbean specialties available Thursdays and Fridays.

cards.title: Historic Courthouse Block
cards.subtitle: North Cass Street
cards.notes: Explore Michigan's oldest county courthouse and historic grounds, which host community events like the 'Stuff a Bus' school drive.
cards.short_summary: A historic museum complex featuring the 1839 County Courthouse.
cards.evidence_claim: The History Center at Courthouse Square is located at 313 N. Cass Street, Berrien Springs, and features the state's oldest county courthouse.
cards.source_title: Home of the State's Oldest County Courthouse - Berrien County Historical Association
cards.access_notes: Museum buildings open Wednesday-Saturday 10am-5pm; grounds open dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Downtown Pizza Block
cards.subtitle: East Ferry Street
cards.notes: Grab a slice at this long-standing downtown pizzeria, formerly known as Roma Pizzeria, located in a historic building.
cards.short_summary: A historic downtown pizzeria serving the community since 1969.
cards.evidence_claim: Town Hall Pizza is located at the corner of Ferry St and Cass St in downtown Berrien Springs.
cards.source_title: Contact Us - Town Hall Pizza - Berrien Springs, MI
cards.access_notes: Open for carry-out and dine-in; street parking available on Ferry St.

cards.title: Filipino Market Block
cards.subtitle: North Cass Street
cards.notes: Find Filipino specialty groceries and prepared vegan-friendly dishes like tofu stew and vegetable fried rice at this local market.
cards.short_summary: A Filipino grocery market and deli on North Cass Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Mabuhay Ethnic Foods is located at 111 N Cass St, Berrien Springs, offering Filipino groceries and prepared foods.
cards.source_title: Mabuhay Ethnic Foods - Berrien Springs Michigan Restaurant - HappyCow
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Saturday; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: Oriental Market Block
cards.subtitle: East Ferry Street
cards.notes: Shop for a variety of Asian grocery staples and specialty ingredients at this downtown market located near the village center.
cards.short_summary: An Asian grocery store located on East Ferry Street.
cards.evidence_claim: New Berrien Springs Oriental Supermarket is located at 116 E Ferry St, Berrien Springs.
cards.source_title: New Berrien Springs Oriental Supermarket, 116 E Ferry St, mappa post
cards.access_notes: Standard retail hours; located in the downtown commercial district.

cards.title: Luthier Shop Block
cards.subtitle: West Ferry Street
cards.notes: Visit this specialized service center for guitar repairs and handcrafted instruments, a unique fixture of the downtown area.
cards.short_summary: A guitar repair and service center on West Ferry Street.
cards.evidence_claim: J Burda Guitars is located at 105 W Ferry Street, Berrien Springs, MI.
cards.access_notes: Open for professional guitar services and sales.

cards.title: Farm Market Corridor
cards.subtitle: Highway M-139
cards.notes: Pick your own seasonal fruit or buy local jams and honey at this expansive farm market just a short drive from campus.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal U-pick farm and market on Highway M-139.
cards.evidence_claim: Stover's Farm Market & U-Pic is located at 7837 M-139, Berrien Springs, and offers no admission fee for U-pick activities.
cards.access_notes: Open May through early November; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: Natural Foods Block
cards.subtitle: US Highway 31
cards.notes: Shop for vegetarian and health-conscious groceries at this market located directly across from the Berrien County Youth Fairgrounds.
cards.short_summary: A vegetarian-focused natural foods market on US Highway 31.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Valley Natural Foods is located at 9067 US Hwy 31, Berrien Springs, and specializes in vegetarian food.
cards.source_title: Berrien Springs - Apple Valley Natural Foods
cards.access_notes: Closed on Saturdays; open until 10:00 PM most other nights.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique spiritual, cultural, and competitive traditions that define the Seventh-day Adventist flagship experience at Andrews University.

cards.title: The Easter Passion Play
cards.subtitle: A walk-through theatrical experience
cards.notes: Join over 600 volunteers for this immersive outdoor drama depicting the life of Christ across eight campus scenes.
cards.short_summary: An annual interactive walk-through drama involving hundreds of student volunteers and thousands of visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Passion Play is an interactive indoor and outdoor walk-through experience with 8 scenes throughout the campus of Andrews University.
cards.source_title: About - Passion Play - Pioneer Memorial Church
cards.access_notes: Free admission; tickets are typically required for specific time slots to manage the large crowds.

cards.title: International Food Fair
cards.subtitle: Global flavors in Johnson Gym
cards.notes: Sample authentic dishes from dozens of countries at this high-energy cultural celebration held every April.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing tradition where student clubs sell traditional foods from their home countries to the community.
cards.evidence_claim: The International Food Fair is a cherished tradition at Andrews, bringing together campus and community in Johnson Gym.
cards.access_notes: Held in Johnson Gym; food is purchased using tickets sold at the door for $1 each.

cards.title: Almost Anything Goes
cards.subtitle: The ultimate class battle
cards.notes: Wear your class colors and compete in wacky relay games and trivia to win the giant class trophy.
cards.short_summary: A high-energy night of inter-class competition featuring glow-in-the-dark games and school spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: Andrews University hosted its 41st annual Almost Anything Goes event, a long-standing tradition featuring eight games and four teams.
cards.source_title: Almost Anything Goes: A Night Lit in Neon - Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Typically held on a Saturday night in Johnson Gym; open to all students and alumni.

cards.title: Gymnics Homeshow
cards.subtitle: Acrobatic ministry finale
cards.notes: Watch the university's elite acrosport team perform high-flying stunts and spiritual routines in their season finale.
cards.short_summary: The annual performance of the Andrews University Gymnics, a traveling gymnastics team founded in 1968.
cards.evidence_claim: Homeshow is the epic finale of the AU Gymnics performance season, transforming the gym into a themed custom stage.
cards.access_notes: Performances held at the Andreasen Center for Wellness; tickets are required for the main Saturday night show.

cards.title: Week of Prayer
cards.subtitle: Spiritual revival and co-curriculars
cards.notes: Attend twice-daily services for a week each semester to hear guest speakers and earn required co-curricular credits.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated week of spiritual focus and community gathering held every semester since the school's early years.
cards.evidence_claim: Each semester Andrews University holds a week of prayer that focuses on a certain theme or topic with different speakers.
cards.source_title: Week of Prayer or Presence? :: Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Services are held in Pioneer Memorial Church and other campus venues; open to all students.

cards.title: AUSA Barn Party
cards.subtitle: Fall flannels and mechanical bulls
cards.notes: Don your best western attire for a night of pumpkin painting, hayrides, and line dancing under the stars.
cards.short_summary: An annual fall social event featuring stereotypical autumn activities and country-themed entertainment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Andrews University Student Association hosts an annual barn party featuring games, food, and fall activities.
cards.source_title: AUSA Hosts Annual Barn Party :: Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Often held on the Alumni House lawn or at local farms; tickets may be required for off-campus transport.

cards.title: Bradley Family Harvest Run
cards.subtitle: Homecoming 5K through the Arboretum
cards.notes: Run or walk through the scenic campus and Arboretum during Homecoming weekend to support student scholarships.
cards.short_summary: A chip-timed 5K race that has been a staple of the university's Homecoming weekend for many years.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bradley Family Harvest Run is a chip-timed 5K Run/Walk through the scenic Andrews University campus and Arboretum.
cards.source_title: Bradley Family Harvest Run - Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Starts and finishes at the Andreasen Center for Wellness; registration fee required to participate.

cards.title: Change Day
cards.subtitle: A day of community service
cards.notes: Swap your books for work gloves as the entire campus shuts down for a day of volunteering in the local community.
cards.short_summary: An annual tradition where students and faculty spend a day serving at various locations in Berrien County.
cards.evidence_claim: Andrews University students and faculty are invited to act out their faith during Change Day activities by serving others.
cards.source_title: Divine Direction: Week of Prayer at Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the fall; classes are typically canceled to allow for full participation.

cards.title: Feast of Lights
cards.subtitle: A musical Christmas gift
cards.notes: Experience the Christmas story through bells, choral music, and a live Nativity at this 50-year-old tradition.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Christmas musical program presented by Andrews Academy for the university and local community.
cards.evidence_claim: Feast of Lights—now in its 49th year—is the Christmas musical gift from Andrews Academy to the community.
cards.source_title: Andrews Academy 49th Feast of Lights - YouTube
cards.access_notes: Held at Pioneer Memorial Church; open to the public.

cards.title: Ringing of the Bell
cards.subtitle: Graduation victory chime
cards.notes: Celebrate your academic journey by ringing the victory bell after your final exam or during graduation weekend.
cards.short_summary: A symbolic act performed by graduating students to mark the completion of their degrees.
cards.evidence_claim: Commencement weekend events are rich in pomp and tradition, designed to create cherished memories for graduates.
cards.access_notes: The bell is located on the main campus mall; accessible to all students during graduation periods.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Andrews University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Check In at First Stop
cards.subtitle: The official start of orientation week
cards.notes: Head to the Campus Center to complete your First Stop check-in. This is where you pick up your ID card and orientation materials to begin your journey.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for new student check-in and orientation materials.
cards.evidence_claim: First Stop check-in for new students takes place at the Campus Center during orientation week.
cards.access_notes: Located on the main floor of the Campus Center; check your specific assigned time slot.

cards.title: Friday Night Dinner
cards.subtitle: Vegetarian dining at the Campus Center
cards.notes: Join fellow new students for a vegetarian meal at the Terrace Cafe. It is the primary spot for community dining and meeting your orientation group.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall offering vegetarian and vegan options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Terrace Cafe in the Campus Center serves as the primary dining location for student meals, including Friday night dinner.
cards.access_notes: Open for dinner service; meal plan or card payment required for entry.

cards.title: Attend Proximity Vespers
cards.subtitle: Friday evening spiritual gathering
cards.notes: Experience Proximity, a student-led vespers service. It is a cornerstone of the Friday night experience on campus for worship and reflection.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused Friday evening worship service held at the campus church.
cards.evidence_claim: Proximity Vespers is a recurring Friday night event for students held at Pioneer Memorial Church.
cards.access_notes: Typically starts at 7:30 PM on Friday nights during the academic year.

cards.title: Sabbath Morning Service
cards.subtitle: Traditional worship in the sanctuary
cards.notes: Participate in the traditional Sabbath morning service. It is a major weekly event where the campus and local community gather for worship.
cards.short_summary: The primary Saturday morning worship service for the university community.
cards.evidence_claim: Pioneer Memorial Church hosts traditional Sabbath services at 9:00 AM and 11:45 AM on Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit - Pioneer Memorial Seventh-day Adventist Church
cards.access_notes: Services are open to all; multiple time slots are available on Saturday mornings.

cards.title: Visit the J.N. Andrews Sculpture
cards.subtitle: A landmark for campus tours
cards.notes: Stop by the iconic sculpture of the university's namesake. It is a frequent meeting point for campus tours and a popular spot for new student photos.
cards.short_summary: A central campus monument depicting the university's namesake, John Nevins Andrews.
cards.evidence_claim: The J.N. Andrews Sculpture is a designated stop on campus tours and a central landmark.
cards.source_title: J.N. Andrews Sculpture - Andrews University Virtual Tour
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark accessible 24/7 in the central campus area.

cards.title: Explore the Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Fitness and recreation hub
cards.notes: Check out the fitness floor or the pool at the Andreasen Center. It is the newest facility on campus for student health and recreation.
cards.short_summary: A modern facility featuring a fitness center, pool, and wellness services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Andreasen Center for Wellness provides fitness equipment, a pool, and wellness classes for students.
cards.source_title: Andreasen Center for Wellness :: Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday through Friday; closed on Saturdays for the Sabbath.

cards.title: Stock Up at Apple Valley
cards.subtitle: On-campus grocery and deli
cards.notes: Walk over to Apple Valley Market to grab snacks or dorm essentials. They offer a wide variety of vegetarian and specialty health foods.
cards.short_summary: A university-owned grocery store located on the edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Valley Market is within walking distance of campus and offers student discounts with a valid ID.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check for specific evening closing times.

cards.title: Evening at the Howard
cards.subtitle: World-class music and events
cards.notes: Attend a concert or special event at the Howard Performing Arts Center. This state-of-the-art venue hosts university ensembles and guest artists.
cards.short_summary: A premier concert hall on campus for music performances and university events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Howard Performing Arts Center is a fine arts music hall serving the campus and region with regular concerts.
cards.source_title: Howard Performing Arts Center - Andrews University
cards.access_notes: Event times vary; tickets may be required for specific performances.

cards.title: Find a Study Spot
cards.subtitle: The main academic resource center
cards.notes: Explore the quiet study areas or reserve a group study room in the James White Library to prepare for your first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary library offering extensive collections and study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: James White Library provides collaborative study rooms and quiet spaces for student use.
cards.access_notes: Check library website for current semester hours and room reservation policies.

cards.title: Sunday Afternoon Recreation
cards.subtitle: Home of the Gymnics
cards.notes: Visit Beaty Gym for open recreation or to watch the Gymnics practice. It is a key location for indoor sports and physical activities.
cards.short_summary: A campus gymnasium used for athletics, intramurals, and the Gymnics program.
cards.evidence_claim: Beaty Gym is a primary facility for gymnastics and recreational sports on campus.
cards.access_notes: Access is typically available for students with a valid ID during scheduled hours.
